scope: PR-V of the restart re-examination (AK 2026-11-10; design review 5 APPROVE): the rn1 gap of restart b1. A fill pass that ends with new pages for a day stores that day's station-page product once at the end of the pass, past the ten-minute product gate and only when what the day is made of changed, through the single product worker. A restart read reads, compares and folds today's and yesterday's pages before the older days' catalogs and products and the minute pages, without marking the load complete for S16 early. Tests for the residual product lag and for two processes' products in reverse order. No new cache, budget or restore machinery; no deployment or production mutation.

outside.reason: Station-page product writes after a fill pass, the restart read order and the residual product lag.

fill_window records the days a pass held new pages for and hands them to flush_products at the end of the pass; product_candidates lets such a day pass PRODUCT_EVERY once; read_s3 reads, compares and folds today and yesterday (fold_held) beside the older days' catalogs and products; hourly_page reports whether it held a page; want_products returns the product worker; unit test of the gate
path_notes.server2/tests/domestic/observe_product.r: KMA-STATION-FLUSH tests: the end-of-fill product with no fold and with a running worker, the early fold with held minute pages and with a held older-day product, the residual lag cases and two processes' products in reverse order; the Pages double gains holds, a fetch instant, a first answered hour and its records
